Thank you for downloading the Gentoo Bubble Icons from www.ionbox.org

These icons are meant to supplement the Gentoo Icon Sets [www.gentoo.org]
If you have comments or suggestions you can send an e-mail to wolven@ionbox.org or sign
my guestbook.

 Wolven

- Credits -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

The initial design for these icons was provided by port001@w0r.mine.nu.

Instructions and discussions regarding this icon set can be found on the Gentoo Forums.
[http://forums.gentoo.org/viewtopic.php?t=31958]
